title: The Static of the Rust Belt
author: Dominic Nakamura
blurb: Oscar Thornbury, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, has spent twenty years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
